description: Unofficial .NET client for the MyAnimeList API v2, with OAuth2 PKCE sign-in, automatic token refresh and Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection integration.
releaseNotes:
This release contains 19 commits since v0.0.37: 6 breaking changes, 5 features, 2 bug fixes.

BREAKING CHANGES:
- users: add fields to AnimelistAsync and MangalistAsync - Users.AnimelistAsync and Users.MangalistAsync have a new string? fields parameter before cancellationToken. Pass the cancellation token by name (cancellationToken: ct), and update overrides of these virtual methods to the new signature.
- hide internals behind IMalApiService - resolve IMalApiService instead of MalApiService and use the client interfaces (Client is now ICatalogClient). Rename uses of the generated models, e.g. Data/Data2/Data3/Data4 to AnimeListEdge/AnimeRankingEdge/MangaListEdge/MangaRankingEdge. Public classes are sealed, RegistrationExtensions.API_URI is internal, and ClientConfigurationOptions is removed; bind configuration to your own type. AddMalApiClient no longer registers IMemoryCache.
- rename the API and add enums, sign-out, MalFields - Rename client methods (AnimeGetAsync -> GetAnimeAsync or SearchAnimeAsync, RankingAsync -> GetRankingAsync, My_list_statusPatchAsync -> UpdateListStatusAsync, AnimelistAsync -> GetAnimeListAsync, TopicAsync -> GetTopicAsync, ...) and model properties to PascalCase (Num_episodes -> NumEpisodes). Pass enums instead of strings for ranking types, seasons, sorts and statuses. Read StartDate, FinishDate and Birthday as strings. Implementations of IAuthCache must rename Get to GetAsync and add ClearAsync; IBrowserLoginHandler.Handle becomes HandleAsync with a CancellationToken.
- client: align models with the live API - Properties MAL always sends are non-nullable, so remove null checks and `?.` on them. Collections are IReadOnlyList<T> instead of ICollection<T> or List<T>. Rename AnimeRecommendationAggregationEdgeBase to AnimeRecommendation, ForumTopics to ForumTopicList, ForumTopicsData to ForumTopicSummary, ForumTopicData to ForumTopicDetails, ForumTopicsCreatedBy to ForumUser, ForumTopicPostCreatedBy to ForumPostAuthor and ForumTopicPaging to Paging. In the list status patches, use NumEpisodesWatched instead of NumWatchedEpisodes and pass Tags as a list instead of a comma-separated string. Pass the list status after the id.
- add list status dates and nsfw on user lists - GetAnimeListAsync and GetMangaListAsync take nsfw before cancellationToken. Pass the cancellation token by name, and add the parameter to any class that implements IUsersClient.
- add IsSignedInAsync and keep AnimeSeason a string - AnimeSeason.Season is a string ("winter", "spring", "summer", "fall") instead of the Season enum; compare it with strings or parse it yourself. RedirectUrl must be an http URL; register an

Highlights:
- Assemblies now carry the package version, and the User-Agent sent to the API reports it instead of 0.0.0.
- Requests that MyAnimeList redirects to its error page are now retried quickly instead of hanging until the HttpClient timeout.
- Users.AnimelistAsync and Users.MangalistAsync accept a fields parameter, so list entries can include their list_status.
- IMalApiService and its client interfaces are now the public API, so they can be mocked, and every public type comes with XML documentation and clearer model names.
- The API now uses .NET naming and enums, works without sign-in for public endpoints, and supports signing out.
- Models now match the live API, with non-nullable fields where MAL always sends them, anime theme songs and videos, an nsfw option for searches, and MAL's error code on ApiException.
- List status updates can now set or clear start and finish dates, and the user list methods accept nsfw.
- ILoginClient.IsSignedInAsync tells whether a user is signed in without opening the login page, and token refreshes no longer sign the user out when a request is cancelled.

Features:
- users: add fields to AnimelistAsync and MangalistAsync
- rename the API and add enums, sign-out, MalFields
- client: align models with the live API
- add list status dates and nsfw on user lists
- add IsSignedInAsync and keep AnimeSeason a string

Bug fixes:
- build: stamp real version into assemblies
- retry requests redirected to MAL's error page

Documentation:
- record repo rename and MAL notification
- note missing Native AOT and trimming support
- note Azure CLI usage and Codecov rename sync

All changes: https://github.com/Insire/SoftThorn.MAL.ApiClient/compare/v0.0.37...v0.1.20
